map.：空气 5cm(n=1)+水 3cm(n=1.33) → OPL=5+3.99=: Air 5 cm (n=1) plus water 3 cm (n=1.33) -> OPL = 5 + 3.99 = 8.99 cm; interference depends on whether the OPL difference between paths is an integer multiple of the wavelength.
